evidence: The glass redesign the owner picked from the prototype ("FULL send it", then "RUN IT NOW"). Its tip `34734a7c` ("fix(live): the session list shows the game's name") is in `main`: it shipped in the glass-redesign desk build (docs/archive/RELEASE_STATE_HISTORY.md), and merging it into `main` is a no-op (`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main origin/claude/redesign-glass` prints `main`'s own tree). Kept on the owner's word, 2026-11-02, asked whether to delete it with the batch's leftover branches: "thats the new and current design and i like it were keeping it". The design itself lives in `main` either way; this ref stays as the reference point for the version he approved. Re-derive with `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/claude/redesign-glass origin/main`.
